conversation.contentPreview:
Create a complete single self-contained file `chip8_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html` (HTML + CSS + JavaScript inline;
no external libraries, CDNs, assets or backend). Build a working CHIP-8 emulator.

Implement the interpreter properly: 4 KB of memory with the font set loaded at 0x050 and programs at 0x200,
sixteen 8-bit registers V0 to VF, the 16-bit index register, the program counter, a call stack, and the
delay and sound timers counting down at 60 Hz. Decode and execute the complete instruction set of 35
instructions, including the arithmetic and logic group with the carry and borrow flags in VF, the shift
instructions, jumps and calls, the random instruction, BCD conversion, register save and load, and the key
tests.

The display is 64 by 32 pixels drawn on a canvas scaled to a readable size, with sprites drawn by XOR and
the collision flag set in VF. The 16-key keypad is mapped to a 4 by 4 block of keyboard keys shown in the
interface; key press and release must both reach the emulator.

Include a small demo ROM as a byte array inside the file: a real program, assembled by you, that draws a
sprite and moves or reacts to a key, so that the emulator can be tried without any download. Also allow
loading a ROM from a local file.

Add run, pause, single step and reset controls, an adjustable instructions-per-frame speed, and a debugger
panel showing the registers, the index register, the program counter, the stack and the decoded current
instruction. Every visible control must work. Deliver the one file `chip8_openai-gpt-6.1-sol_01.html`.

Fx1E wraps I16 bits and leaves VF unchanged. Fx0A advances PC once then sets wait register until next fresh press, waiting does not busy-loop and timers continue while running; ignore held-key repeats, allow input while paused. Font address I=0x50+(Vx&15)*5. Memory checks for I operations.
Use requestAnimationFrame with time accumulator for logical60Hz frames, clamp elapsed to250ms, each frame executes chosen instructions unless waiting; delay and sound decrement each logical tick; no huge catchup after resume. Sound WebAudio oscillator low volume beep while running ST>0 and enabled, initialized/resumed from user Run/Step/sound actions, gracefully handle unsupported/audio errors. Pause stops sound and timers; Step executes exactly one opcode while paused (not artificial timer tick). Reset reloads currently selected ROM resets all state, framebuffer, keys, timers, stack, and pauses. ROM file async loader validate nonempty max3584 .ch8 etc arbitrary binary allowed; errors leave old ROM intact; display filename via textContent. Clear file input for reselect. on blur/visibility hidden release all keys, pause hidden tab. Keyboard map Digit1 Digit2 Digit3 Digit4 / KeyQ KeyW KeyE KeyR / KeyA KeyS KeyD KeyF / KeyZ KeyX KeyC KeyV => hex 1,2,3,C /4,5,6,D /7,8,9,E /A,0,B,F. Keydown/up reaches emulator, prevent repeats and browser shortcuts only handled keys when no ctrl/meta/alt and not editable/input/select. Use pointerdown/up/cancel plus pointer capture for on-screen keys and active visual state, avoid stuck keys incl simultaneous keyboard/pointer via sources set. Key buttons accessible labels. Canvas accessible aria-label.
Include real demo ROM as literal Uint8Array bytes with address comments, assembled exactly as follows. Sprite starts at address0x244; use I=244. Demo moves with host W/A/S/D (CHIP5/7/8/9) and uses delay to pace. The opcodes by address are: 200 00E0;202 601E;204 610E;206 A244;208 D015;20A 6202;20C F215;20E F207;210 3200;212 120E;214 D015;216 6305;218 E3A1;21A 71FF;21C 6308;21E E3A1;220 7101;222 6307;224 E3A1;226 70FF;228 6309;22A E3A1;22C 7001;22E 643F;230 8042;232 641F;234 8142;236 D015;238 120A;23A..242 five 0000 padding opcodes;244 sprite bytes 0x70,0xF8,0xA8,0xF8,0x70. Thus sprite is 5px across x5 tall, instructions run without unsupported padding. Comment explain movement erase XOR then redraw, wrap coordinates. Provide visible demo controls W up A left S down D right and hint keyboard mapping differs from CHIP hex. The ROM must be directly embedded byte array not JS-only animation. Ensure drawing boot/reset immediate blank then demo actually draws when run/step. Render debugger every RAF or state updates via DOM created safely once. Disassembler cover all supported instruction forms accurately and unknown label, current wait indication. Include stack return addresses.
